title: Live __main__ read before write
objective: Preserve Python module LOAD_NAME semantics in reusable kernel cells so a same-cell assignment RHS can read the prior live Sage global or builtin without host leakage or weakening deletion and uninitialized-name guards

oracles: CPython module LOAD_NAME semantics for same-name reads before assignment
The live Sage __main__ namespace across reset and subsequent kernel cells

handoff.summary: Restored module LOAD_NAME behavior for same-cell reads before assignment in reusable __main__ fragments without weakening deleted or uninitialized name isolation. New module bindings start with a unique fragment sentinel; code generation lets only that fresh state continue through the existing module/builtins/host resolution path, while a prior value is reused and an undefined tombstone remains authoritative. Each namespace getter captures the creating fragment's sentinel identity, so a later runInThisContext fragment cannot expose an older marker. Focused coverage exercises reset('i'); i = CC(i), a same-name Python builtin assignment, prior-cell value reuse, prior- and same-cell deletion without JavaScript host resurrection, and a failed fresh RHS across an unrelated later cell. Exact successor source 731ce693f7e10e2bf56260acbc9e367bdb99b318 passed the self-hosting build, compiled-module tests (15/15), kernel test, tour_rings (32/32), full tutorial corpus (662/662), compiler suite (15 pass and 17 historical skips), integration tier (439 pass and 3 expected skips), architecture checks, and strict baselib checks.
risks: Do not integrate the earlier source commit 8dba1290794783ca0afa73413657fba75f8f304e by itself. Independent review found that its fixed top-level sentinel could leak an old marker after a later fragment replaced the global sentinel; successor 731ce693f7e10e2bf56260acbc9e367bdb99b318 captures the per-fragment identity in each getter and includes the exact three-cell regression.

Validation ran on Linux x64. The change is architecture-neutral compiler-generated JavaScript and does not add or alter a platform capability, native dependency, or fallback, so Linux arm64, Windows x64, and macOS arm64 are not applicable to this narrow semantic lane.
next_steps: Preserve the ordered corrective source authority 731ce693f7e10e2bf56260acbc9e367bdb99b318 and its per-fragment sentinel regression through release integration.
After compiler integration, rerun pnpm test:tutorial on the blocked website-release-consistency source and issue its successor closure with a fresh 662/662 receipt.
Rerun final aggregate compiler, integration, tutorial, and changed-file gates on the frozen release baseline.
